audience: training teams and course creators who run learner programs in AcademyOcean

useCases.title: Find learners who never opened a lesson
useCases.text: List the learners who registered but never opened a lesson. Then read one learner's progress in each course before you follow up.

useCases.title: Track where learners stop in a course
useCases.text: List the learners who completed a course. Then find the lesson or quiz where other learners stopped progressing.

useCases.title: Review every learner's progress in one course
useCases.text: Find the course id in the course list. Then read the lesson and quiz progress of every learner in that course, page by page.

useCases.title: Check quiz results and high scores
useCases.text: List the learners whose score matches a value, such as 80 or more. Then read their quiz attempts with scores and timing.

useCases.title: Look up one learner's certificates
useCases.text: Find a learner by email in the learner list. Then read the certificates issued to that learner, with the course name and PDF link.
